cueCards.label: An idea
cueCards.prompt: Explain one idea you know well.

cueCards.label: A project
cueCards.prompt: Introduce a project you're proud of.

cueCards.prompt: Give an opinion on a familiar topic.

cueCards.prompt: Teach a simple task step by step.

cueCards.prompt: Tell the story of a decision you made.
